get.description: Returns ok, the service name and the running version. Not rate-limited.

post.description: Use made-up details. This is a demo. When mail is on, sends a link to confirm the email address.

400.description: Invalid details, or we could not create this account

post.description: Answers an access token and sets the refresh_token cookie. With two-step sign-in on, answers only a challenge for POST /auth/2fa/verify instead.

403.description: Check your email to confirm your account

429.description: 5 wrong tries for this email in 15 minutes: wait 15 minutes

post.description: Takes the challenge sign-in answered and the 6-digit code from the authenticator app, or a recovery code. Each code works once, and a challenge allows at most 5 wrong codes. Answers an access token and sets the refresh_token cookie, as sign-in does.

401.description: The code is not right, or sign in again (also after 5 wrong codes on one challenge)

429.description: 5 wrong codes for this account in 15 minutes: wait 15 minutes

post.description: Takes the token from the link in the sign-up mail. Each link works once.

400.description: This link is not valid any more

post.description: Always answers 202, whether or not the email has an account; only an account gets the mail. The link works once, for 1 hour.

202.description: If the email has an account, a reset link is on its way

post.summary: Ask for a password reset link

post.description: Always answers 202 with no body, whatever the email: only an unconfirmed account gets the mail, and only when mail is on. The new link works once, for 24 hours; older links stop working.

202.description: If the email has an unconfirmed account, a new link is on its way

post.summary: Ask for a new email confirmation link

post.description: Takes the token from the reset link and a new password. Each link works once, and every session of the account ends.

204.description: The password is changed; sign in again

400.description: This link is not valid any more, or the password is too short or too long

post.description: Swaps the refresh_token cookie for a new access token and a new cookie. Each cookie works once; using one twice signs out every copy.

401.description: No usable refresh token: sign in again

403.description: This request must come from the Manasbal shop: the Origin header is not in WEB_ORIGINS, or is missing while the refresh_token cookie is sent

post.description: Revokes the session's refresh tokens and clears the cookie.

403.description: This request must come from the Manasbal shop: the Origin header is not in WEB_ORIGINS, or is missing while the refresh_token cookie is sent

post.description: Makes a new authenticator-app secret for the signed-in user. It is not on until POST /auth/2fa/enable gets a code from the app.

403.description: Two-step sign-in is off for demo logins

post.description: Takes the 6-digit code from the authenticator app. Answers the recovery codes, which are shown only this once.

400.description: The code is not right, or set-up was not started

429.description: 5 wrong codes for this account in 15 minutes: wait 15 minutes

post.description: Takes a current 6-digit code from the authenticator app, or a recovery code. Removes the secret and every recovery code.
